content: Epuzo okukumanena ni Liywaa no Pumulo
Ba liywaa linjili no Pumulo, Jesu yo bita mu matema no ubeke, aiyetwa aye sebeli ayangula amakunka no ubeke, ni kwapolola mu maoko oo ni kulya oubeke.
Kono anjili no Afalisi sebeli aamba nji, “Iikene aba mutenda eyi no kwafanena ba liywaa no Pumulo?”
Cwale Jesu sebeli otambula nji, “Kamwa sikubala eyo ana ku tenda Dabida yo yombile, yonyene naawo ana kwikala naye?
Omo ana kwingenena mu ndoo ya Nyambe, noomo ana kushimbela ni kulya esinkwa sina ku lukisetwa Nyambe, eyo nakwafanena okuliwa ku munu yonje konji apulisita, mi sebeli obako nawo ana kwikala naye.”
Cwale Jesu sebeli wamba kwa onyene nji, “Omwana no Munu ni Mbumu no Pumulo.”
Omulume osi Lyoko no Lun̄an̄ali
Ba liywaa elinjili no Pumulo, Jesu aba ana kwingena mu ndoo no milapelo ni kwiyetamo, na ku kwikala omulume osi ku kukutela olun̄an̄ali ku lyooko no silyo.
Afalisi anjili na iyeti no mulawo sebeli aaliketa Jesu oku mona nji mba balisa omunu ba liywaa no Pumulo, nji cwale awane elibaka no kumununga eyambo.
Kono Jesu sebeli olimuka emihupulo yoo, mi sebeli wamba ku mulume osiku kukutela elyoko nji, “Wiiye wimane bano.” Cwale sebeli oimana ni kuta ba lubala no aanu.
Cwale Jesu sebeli wamba kwa onyene nji, “Kame nimi ibanguta nji, kakufanene eli no Pumulo okutenda eyi no kuwaba simba okutenda ouyi? Oku yoyisa omooyo nji okuusinya?”
Cwale sebeli waaliketa onje ni kwambela woyo mulume nji, “Oolole elyooko lyowe.” Mi sebeli otenda ngeeso, cwale elyoko lyaye sebeli libala.
Kono sebeli aiyala okutweba nuukwambisa mukaci koo eso sa fanene okutenda kwa Jesu.
Jesu yo Keta Atumiwa Aye no kukwana Likumi ni Twiili (12)
Mu maywaa aa Jesu sebeli ota ku lilundu oka lapela, mi usiku onje yotwalelela okulapela kwa Nyambe.
Cwale aba lina kupa eliywaa, sebeli oisana aiyetwa aye, ni kuketa mwa onyene aa no kukwana likumi na yiili, awo ana kubeekiwa nji atumiwa.
Simoni, ana kubeeka elitina lya Pitolosi, ni Adiliyasi minaye, Jakobo, ni Jowani, ni Filipi, ni Batolome,
ni Mateu, ni Tomasi ni Jakobo omwana Alufeya, ni Simoni wisanwa nji Zeloti,
ni Judasi Mwana Jakobo, ni Judasi Isikaliota, omubeteki.
Jesu yo Iyeta ni ku Balisa

Cwale sebeli oshetumuka noo ni kwimana ba saana, ni kupula no aiyetwa aye naanu no kupula ana ku tunda mu Judeya monje ni mu Jelusalema ni ba likamba lya Tile ni Sidoni, ana kwiiya mu kumuteeteta ni ku balisiwa ku meeti oo,
naawo ana ku ziyeleha ku mebo no kwiiba naku balisiwa.
Cwale oundi no aanu sebeli ayeya nji amuleme, kakuli amaata kame ana kutunda kwa yonyene ni kwaa balisa onje.
Oku Wabelelwa ni Kweena
Cwale sebeli waliketa aiyetwa aye ni kwamba nji,

content.text: kakuli omubuso wa Nyambe ni wenu!
Embuyoti ni yenu anyi mu yombile bano,
Embuyoti ni yenu anyi mu lila bano,

content: “Embuyoti ni yenu aba mutimbiwa kwaanu, naaba amicita, naaba amyangola, ni kukana elitina lyenu kanyi lyakwiiba, mulibaka lya Mwana no Munu!
Mu wabelelwe mu liywaa elyo, mu nenge mu ku nyakalala, kakuli komone, omupuzo wenu ni wakuneneba ku wilu, kakuli anjekulyenu naaku tenda ngeeso kwa nuhi a Nyambe.

content.text: kakuli na mu tambula omooyo no kotoba!
Oumai ni wenu anyi mwiikutile bano,
Oumai ni wenu anyi musheka bano,

content: “Oumai ni wenu, abo aanu onje aba aamba ouwa wenu, kakuli anjekulyoo kame ana kutenda ngeeso kwa nuhi no mapwa.
Elilato ku Iila
“Kono kame namba kwaanyi muyupa, mu singe eila yenu, mu tende wino kwawo ami timbile,
mu fuyole awo amikuta, mu lapelele awo ami timbile.
Woyo okufula ku litama limweya omube akufule kame ku litama linjili, mi omunu nji aku byangule ebaki yowe omube mane ni hembe yowe.
Obe woyo okumbela kwa wene, ni woyo oshimba einu yowe olese ku mubyangulayo kame.
Cwale omu musingela nji aanu ami tendele, naanyi mutende ngeeso kwa onyene.
“Nji kame musinga awo ami singa, kawitumelo sa mu mone? Kakuli simba asikutenda eibi kame asinga awo aasinga!
Cwale nji otenda ouwa kwaawo atenda ouwa kwa wene, ka witumelo sau mone? kakuli simba nonyene asi kutenda eibi mwatendela ngeeso!
Cwale nji kame mukalima awo mu sepile nji mba myusete, ka witumelo sa mu mone? Simba asiku tenda eibi, kame akalimana nawo atenda eibi, nji ausetwe mukupula ngeeso.

Kono mu singe eila yenu, mwaa tende wino, mwaa kolotise me mwabilaele nji muusetwe esinjili, mi omupuzo wenu kame saunenebe, mi kame sa mu tende aana a Nyambe Oli Beulu, kakuli yonyene niwa sishemo kwaawo no kwaku tumela naawo akusinga onyene.
Mwikale ni makeke kanyi Sitenu aba ali ni makeke.
Okwatula Akwenu
“Mu lese kwatula nji naanyi muulwe okwatuliwa, mu lese oku nyaza nji naanyi muulwe oku nyaziwa, mu lemene akwenu nji naanyi mu lemenwe.

Mube, nji naanyi mubiwe, niti luli kame sa mu tambule empo no utokwa eyo saibeekwe mu makaa enu. Kakuli esikala no kuwaba, mwetela banji mane mwinyunge bamweya, mwituke beulu mi mbaibekiwa ba yeelo yenu. Kakuli esikala muba kwa kwenu, naanyi sokame eso sa muwane.”
Kame Jesu sebeli waambela enguli nji, “Kana esibofu kame sitwesa oku twaletela esibofu sinjili? Yonje kaitamba okukwela mu wina?”
Omwiyetwa katwese okubitelela omwiyeti waye, kono omunu yonje aba ana mana okwiyetiwa kame safeke kanyi omwiyeti waye.
Ngasibine waliketa esoopu sili mu litiyo no mwabowe, kono wene kumono omusumo oli mu litiyo lyowe?

Simba nji ngasibine so twesete okwambela omwabowe nji, ‘Mwabange, tumone ni kutundise esoopu sili mu litiyo lyowe,’ abo weene kumono omusumo owo oli mu litiyo lyowe? Wene osikukuba, oweli otundise omusumo oli mu litiyo lyowe, okubinda cwale somone wino oku tundisa esoopu sili mu litiyo no mwabowe.
Esitondo ni Mbuya Yaso
“Kakuli kakwisa esitondo no kuwaba sibeeke embuya no kwiiba, simba nji kame esitondo no kwiiba sibeeke embuya no kuwaba.
Mulibaka elyo esitondo sonje kame silimukelwa ku mbuya yaso sibeeka, kakuli etifeiga kati yangulwa ku mikakani, simba esisansa no beine kasi yangulwa ku mukona.

Omunu no kuwaba kame atundisa eyi no kuwaba mu sitewelo na mu mucima waye, mi omunu no kwiiba kame atundisa eyi no kwiiba mu sitewelo saye no kwiiba, kakuli akanwa no munu kame kaamba eso siiyalile mu mucima waye.
Ayaki Ayiili no Ndoo
“Ngasibine aba mu niisana nji ‘Mbumu, Mbumu,’ mi ka mutende eso ni myambela?
Omunu yonje woyo wiiya kwa mene ni ku teeteta ku maywi ange ni kwasebelisa, mbimi simwete eso aku fekile naso.

Kame aku fekile kanyi omulume oyaka endoo yaye, woyo ona kutungisa onene bakutombola, ni kuyaka omutomo waye ba liwee, mi cwale omuunda aba wiiya, ameyi aba afula onene ba ndoo, mi katwese okunyanganyisa endoo eyo, kakuli kame iyakilwe wino.

Kono woyo oyupa amaywi ange mi kaasebelisa, kame akufekile kanyi omulume oyaka endoo yaye ba mumbu feela aba nambulwa omutomo, mi ameyi aba afulabo onene ababo kame ikwa, mi oku sinyeha no ndoo eyo kame sakutende oku no kuneneba onene!”
